name: context-menu-19
description: A leaderboard whose ordering is controlled by radio items in the context menu.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuRadioGroup, ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" const players = [ { name: "Templates", score: 9120, joined: 3 }, { name: "Blocks", score: 11840, joined: 1 }, { name: "Icons", score: 7600, joined: 4 }, { name: "Logos", score: 10230, joined: 2 }, ] export default function SortOrderRadioMenu() { const [sort, setSort] = React.useState("score") const sorted = [...players].sort((a, b) => sort === "score" ? b.score - a.score : sort === "name" ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : a.joined - b.joined ) return (
Top Designali products by {sort}
{sorted.map((player, index) => (
{index + 1} {player.name} {player.score.toLocaleString()}
))} Sort by Highest score Name (A–Z) First to join ) }
